badge.name: Badge
badge.purpose: Represent compact counts and status markers attached to a parent component.

anatomy.rule: Owns marker size, radius, background, and alignment.
Shows a short count, word, icon, or dot.
Belongs to a parent component accessible name.

intents.description: Accent marker using Flow action semantics.

badge.statePrecedence: disabled > hidden > focus > hover > overflow > default

Energy.decision: Use Energy for tone, contrast, and disabled marker treatment.
Energy.behavior: Badge uses semantic color only as a compact marker.

Voice.decision: Use Voice for short labels and overflow wording.

Frame.decision: Use Frame for pill, dot, border, and alignment.

Depth.decision: Use Depth only through parent context.
Depth.example: Badge on Card inherits surface context.

Momentum.decision: Use Momentum for parent state only.

State.decision: Use State for hidden, overflow, disabled, focus, and default.

Tone.decision: Use Tone for semantic meaning and accessible wording.

Growth.decision: Use Growth to keep Badge reusable across tabs, chips, cards, and tables.
Growth.example: Same count marker in tab and card.

Symbol.decision: Use Symbol for icon variant only.

Iconography.decision: Use Iconography for icon size and alignment.

Accessibility.decision: Use Accessibility through parent association and ariaLabel.
Accessibility.behavior: Badge meaning is exposed to assistive tech.

productExamples.example: Risk marker on a fleet card.
Pending approval count in row metadata.

dont: Do not make Badge a standalone action.
info: Badge enables Tabs, Chip, Card, and table patterns.

contextDensityStrategy.layout: paired count and status where labels fit
dense table, tabs, and card markers

agentInstructions: Use Badge only as a marker attached to another component.
Choose tone from source semantics, not decoration.
Ask when count source or accessible wording is unclear.

props.name: state
props.notes: Local display state: default, hover, focus, overflow, hidden, or disabled.

props.name: hidden
props.notes: Hides the badge when the parent state requires it.

props.name: icon
props.notes: Approved icon name for the icon badge variant.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.notes: Accessible meaning when visible text is not enough.
